definitive_answers.Q2_what_does_0_447_represent: A clerical typo / mislabeling in the Phase 15 Markdown audit report. It corresponds to no artifact, no parameter, and no mathematical formula in the system.
definitive_answers.Q3_what_does_1_317657_represent: The true optimal temperature scaling parameter T learned on the 21,000-record calibration set to minimize cross-entropy log loss and Expected Calibration Error (ECE).
definitive_answers.Q4_which_value_is_actually_used_in_produ: T = 1.317656719700599. All production components (IoTIntrusionDetector, CompleteIDSPipeline, predict_with_temperature.py) load calibrator_temperature.pkl directly.
definitive_answers.Q5_are_phase_14_15_results_valid: YES. All evaluations, test suites, thresholds, and traces were computed using calibrator_temperature.pkl (T = 1.317657). Zero numbers were computed with 0.447.
definitive_answers.Q6_is_any_code_change_required: NO code change is required. The production model, calibrator, detection engine, and test suites are 100% consistent and intact. Only the clerical typo in the Phase 15 Markdown documentation needs rectification.
